research.topic: Signs It’s Time to Talk to a Mental‑Health Professional – 3 Common Mistakes People Make
research.hook: Stop ignoring these 3 red‑flags if you’re prepping for exams
research.tip: Do a 15‑minute nightly mental‑health check‑in with the PHQ‑4; if you score 3 or higher on either sub‑scale, book a 20‑minute free tele‑counseling session

data.title: Stop doing this if exam ki tension se thak gaye ho
data.title_en: Stop doing this if you're exhausted from exam stress

scenes.text: Kya tum exam ki tension se thak gaye ho?
scenes.text_en: Are you exhausted from exam pressure?
scenes.text_hi: क्या तुम एग्जाम की टेंशन से थक गए हो?

scenes.text: Har roz raat ko phone scroll karte, neend nahi aati.
scenes.text_en: Scrolling on phone every night, you can’t sleep.
scenes.text_hi: हर रोज़ रात को फ़ोन स्क्रॉल करते, नींद नहीं आती।

scenes.text: Research kehti hai, 1 in 5 students ko anxiety hoti hai.
scenes.text_en: Research says 1 in 5 students experience anxiety.
scenes.text_hi: रिसर्च कहती है, 1 इन 5 स्टूडेंट्स को एंग्जायटी होती है।

scenes.text: Galti #1: Sochna ki sirf stress hi hai.
scenes.text_hi: गलती #1: सोचना कि सिर्फ स्ट्रेस ही है।

scenes.text: Galti #2: Sab kuch akela handle karna samajh lo.
scenes.text_en: Mistake #2: Believing you must handle everything alone.
scenes.text_hi: गलती #2: सब कुछ अकेला हैंडल करना समझ लो।

scenes.text: Galti #3: Sirf severe case hi professional ko dikhana.
scenes.text_en: Mistake #3: Showing only severe cases to a professional.
scenes.text_hi: गलती #3: सिर्फ सीवियर केस ही प्रोफेशनल को दिखाना।

scenes.text: Ye line us dost ko bhejo jo raat ko jagta hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this line to the friend who stays up late.
scenes.text_hi: ये लाइन उस दोस्त को भेजो जो रात को जागता है।

scenes.text: Ab ek 15‑minute mental check‑in try karo har raat.
scenes.text_en: Now try a 15‑minute mental check‑in each night.
scenes.text_hi: अब एक 15‑मिनट मेंटल चेक‑इन ट्राय करो हर रात।

scenes.text: Pehle PHQ‑4 ke 4 sawaal padho, jawab likho.
scenes.text_en: First, read the 4 PHQ‑4 questions and write answers.
scenes.text_hi: पहले PHQ‑4 के 4 सवाल पढ़ो, जवाब लिखो।

scenes.text: Agar score 3 ya zyada ho, turant counseling book karo.
scenes.text_en: If the score is 3 or higher, book counseling right away.
scenes.text_hi: अगर स्कोर 3 या ज़्यादा हो, तुरंत काउंसलिंग बुक करो।

scenes.text: Yeh habit apnao, aur apni mental health ko priority do.
scenes.text_en: Adopt this habit and make your mental health a priority.
scenes.text_hi: यह habit अपनाओ, और अपनी mental health को priority दो।

data.description: A quick 45‑second reel showing three common mistakes that stop students from seeking help and a simple 15‑minute check‑in to catch early signs. Speak in Hinglish, keep it relatable and end with a clear actionable tip.

fixes: Align content with the requested topic about signs to see a mental‑health professional and the 3 common mistakes
Replace or qualify the PHQ‑4 recommendation with a disclaimer that it’s not a diagnostic tool
Avoid implying that a specific score mandates counseling without professional assessment
Add a clear, concise call‑to‑action to consult a mental‑health professional

short_final.note: Stop doing this if you're exhausted from exam stress
